title: Investigation Length Allowance on Reversed Claims, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
**Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite plans.** A reversed lost or stolen card claim is due an investigation allowance. It follows the time from the claim's notice date to its resolution date.

- **25.00** when that time is more than 90 calendar days for a new-account, point-of-sale or foreign-initiated transaction, or more than 45 calendar days for any other transaction.
- **10.00** when it is not, but is more than 20 business days for a new-account transaction, or more than 10 business days for any other transaction.
- **Nothing** otherwise.

**Definitions.**
- A new-account transaction is one that posted no more than 30 calendar days after the account's first deposit date.
- A point-of-sale transaction is a purchase.
- A foreign-initiated transaction is one marked as a foreign transaction.
- Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the earlier date through the later one.

## Decision table (hypothetical durations)

| Transaction | Calendar days | Business days | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| ATM withdrawal, not new-account, domestic | 46 | 32 | 25.00 |
| ATM withdrawal, not new-account, domestic | 30 | 21 | 10.00 |
| ATM withdrawal, not new-account, domestic | 13 | 9 | nothing |
| purchase, not new-account | 60 | 42 | 10.00 |
| purchase, not new-account | 91 | 64 | 25.00 |
| ATM withdrawal, new-account | 25 | 17 | nothing |
| ATM withdrawal, new-account | 35 | 24 | 10.00 |
